metadata.description: Validation test for failsafe with the DROP procedure (docs/fpv-hud-gnss-test-plan.md, T08): after a climb the link is lost for 1 s at 5 s — stage 1, sticks held for 0.3 s then throttle low, control back at once — and lost again at 9 s: stage 2 exactly 1.5 s later, and the quad disarms.
